We need to determine the crimes based on facts. The case: Yang, a religious organization official (Christian three-self movement) and center hall accountant. He used position to embezzle public funds (unit funds) via false reimbursements, etc. Also misappropriated special donation funds (disaster relief funds) for personal or other uses. So crimes: "职务侵占" (embezzlement of public funds by a public official) and "挪用特定款物" (misappropriation of designated funds). In Chinese criminal law, the relevant crimes are:

- Embezzlement (职务侵占罪) – for public funds.
- Misappropriation of designated funds (挪用特定款物罪) – for disaster relief funds.

Thus answer should list both: [罪名]职务侵占;挪用特定款物<eoa>
